turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, Nani? It is me, Rahul. Please tell me you can hear me clearly.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Rahul? Beta, why are you calling from this new number? Is everything okay?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nani, I am in a big mess. I had a small accident with a car in Pune and the police are very angry.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh my god, are you hurt? Do I need to call your father right now?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, no! Please do not tell Papa, he will kill me. I just need to settle this with the police quickly and go home.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: But how can you settle it alone? What exactly happened there?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It was a misunderstanding, but they are asking for a security deposit to release me. I am so scared, Nani.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I do not understand. Why can't you call your friends or use your own account?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: My phone is broken and I have no access to my bank. I need one lakh rupees immediately to pay the officer.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: One lakh is a lot of money, Rahul. Let me think how to arrange this.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please hurry, Nani, they are giving me only one hour. I will send you the UPI details on WhatsApp right now.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Wait, let me just call your mother first to check if she knows about this.
